name: onboard
tagline_zh: 新用户首次见面，AI 起名、定人格、建档案，一条龙仪式。还能单独改灵魂或用户档，或精准更新某条记忆文件。
tagline_en: First-run ceremony: name, personality, profiles, optional browser. Or update just one file—soul, user, or.
desc_en: Onboard a new user OR curate a single piece of the assistant's inner state. Without arguments, runs the full first-run ceremony (AI name, personality, user profile, SOUL.md + USER.md, optional browser + personal website). With `scope:soul` or `scope:user`, runs a quick chat to update just that one profile file. With `path:<abs>`, runs a quick chat to update / keep / delete one memory file under ~/
why_zh: 同类工具要么全量重跑，要么手动改文件。它用对话精准定位单文件，仪式感与微调兼得。
why_en: Unlike full re-runs or manual edits, it uses chat to surgically update one file—ceremony and precision in one.
